phrase.zh: 从一处传来的微小变化，能在另一处得到回应。
phrase.en: A small change carried from one place can find a response in another.

visual.zh: 大浅皿裁在左下，小浅皿置于右上，各有一个红褐色组织示意；玻璃滴管左端连接深绿挤压球，右侧细尖上形成一滴液体。浅绿玻璃以环形刻线塑形，黑白版保留位置和关系。
visual.en: A large cropped dish at lower left and a smaller dish at upper right each contain a reddish-brown tissue form. A long glass pipette joins a dark-green squeeze bulb at left to a narrow tip at right, where a droplet forms. Fine circular engraving shapes the pale-green glass; neutral monochrome preserves positions and relationships.

background.zh:
勒维与戴尔共同获得1936年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖，表彰有关神经信号化学传递的发现。1921年的蛙心实验中，一处心脏周围的营养液转移到另一处后，后者出现相似反应，支持化学物质传递信号的解释。两只浅皿、蛙心组织示意与滴管尖端的一滴液体表达传递关系，是原创寓意，不是原实验装置、精确解剖或治疗说明；短句为原创。
1936年生理学或医学奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：发现神经信号的化学传递
background.en:
Loewi and Dale shared the 1936 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for discoveries relating to chemical transmission of nerve impulses. In Loewi’s 1921 frog-heart experiment, nutrient fluid transferred from around one heart produced a similar response in another, supporting chemical signal transmission. Two dishes, simplified frog-heart tissue forms and a droplet at the pipette tip express an original metaphor for transfer, not the original apparatus, exact anatomy or treatment advice. The phrase is original.
1936 — The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: for their discoveries relating to chemical transmission of nerve impulses
